SequenceMemory.title: Sequence Memory
SequenceMemory.description: Sequence Memory is a cognitive training tool modeled after the classic 'Simon' game. It tests your short-term working memory.

items: Watch the grid of colored tiles carefully.
A sequence of lights and sounds will play.
Repeat the sequence exactly by clicking the tiles.
The sequence gets one step longer each round.

faqs.question: How is the score calculated?
faqs.answer: Your score represents the length of the longest sequence you successfully reproduced.

ReflexHammer.title: Reflextry
ReflexHammer.description: Simulate a clinical knee-jerk reflex test to measure your neural reaction speed.

items: Wait for the hammer to appear.
Click or tap immediately when you see the visual stimulus.
The reaction time will be recorded in milliseconds.
Try to get closer to a realistic physiological reflex time (20-110ms is superhuman!).

faqs.question: What is a normal reflex time?
faqs.answer: A physical knee-jerk reflex takes about 30-50ms (monosynaptic), but a visual reaction on a screen inevitably takes longer (avg 200-250ms) due to visual processing.

faqs.question: Does this replace a doctor?
faqs.answer: No. This is a game for entertainment and cognitive testing, not a medical device.

About.title: About Reflextry
About.subtitle: Empowering cognitive excellence through innovative brain training tools

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Reflextry is dedicated to making cognitive training accessible, engaging, and effective for everyone. We believe that everyone deserves the tools to enhance their mental abilities, improve their cognitive performance, and achieve their full potential. Our platform provides evidence-based brain training games and cognitive assessment tools designed to help users improve memory, reaction time, typing speed, accuracy, and gaming skills through regular practice and training.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Reflextry was founded with a simple yet powerful vision: to democratize access to high-quality cognitive training tools. We recognized that traditional brain training solutions were often expensive, inaccessible, or not based on scientific evidence. Our team of cognitive science enthusiasts, developers, and researchers came together to create a platform that combines cutting-edge technology with evidence-based training methods.
story.paragraph2: Our journey began with a commitment to providing free, accessible cognitive training tools that actually work. We've spent countless hours researching cognitive science literature, developing engaging training exercises, and refining our platform based on user feedback and scientific evidence. Today, Reflextry offers over 20 different cognitive training tools across 5 major categories, serving users worldwide in multiple languages.
story.paragraph3: We're passionate about cognitive enhancement and continuously work to improve our platform. Our team stays current with the latest research in cognitive science, neuroscience, and brain training to ensure our tools are based on the best available evidence. We believe in transparency, user privacy, and providing value through our free platform.

values.title: Our Values
values.accuracyDesc: Every tool and feature on Reflextry is grounded in scientific research and evidence-based practices. We prioritize accuracy and effectiveness over flashy features, ensuring that our users receive real, measurable cognitive benefits from their training.
values.innovationDesc: We leverage cutting-edge web technologies to create responsive, engaging, and accessible cognitive training experiences. Our platform continuously evolves to incorporate the latest research findings and user feedback, ensuring we remain at the forefront of cognitive training innovation.
values.accessibilityDesc: Cognitive enhancement shouldn't be limited by cost or accessibility. Reflextry is completely free to use, available in multiple languages, and designed to work seamlessly across all devices. We believe everyone deserves access to quality cognitive training tools.
values.userFirstDesc: Our users are at the heart of everything we do. We design our tools based on user needs, gather continuous feedback, and prioritize user experience. Your cognitive development and success drive our platform improvements and feature development.

offer.title: What We Offer
offer.brainTraining: Our memory games include sequence memory, number memory, visual memory, color memory (Stroop test), shape memory, and symbol memory exercises. These tools are designed to improve working memory, short-term memory, and pattern recognition abilities through engaging, progressively challenging exercises.
offer.reactionTests: Test and improve your reaction time with our comprehensive reflex testing tools. From visual reaction tests to audio reaction tests, peripheral vision tests, and directional reflex tests, we offer multiple ways to measure and enhance your response speed and reflexes.
offer.progressTracking: Monitor your cognitive development with detailed statistics, progress charts, and performance analytics. Track improvements across all tools, identify strengths and areas for growth, and set personal goals to guide your cognitive training journey.
offer.achievements: Stay motivated with our achievements and challenges system. Unlock badges for milestones, complete daily challenges to maintain streaks, and celebrate your progress as you reach new levels of cognitive performance.

community.title: Join Our Community
community.description: Reflextry is more than just a platform—it's a community of individuals committed to cognitive excellence. Whether you're a student looking to improve academic performance, a professional seeking to enhance productivity, a gamer aiming to sharpen reflexes, or simply someone interested in maintaining mental sharpness, you'll find tools, resources, and support to help you achieve your cognitive goals.

cta.title: Start Your Cognitive Training Journey
cta.description: Ready to improve your memory, reaction time, and cognitive abilities? Explore our comprehensive collection of brain training tools and start your journey toward enhanced cognitive performance today.

team.title: About Our Team
team.description: Reflextry is developed by a dedicated team of cognitive science researchers, software engineers, and UX designers who are passionate about making cognitive training accessible and effective. Our team combines expertise in cognitive psychology, neuroscience, software development, and user experience design to create tools that are both scientifically sound and user-friendly.
team.expertise: Our team members have backgrounds in cognitive science, psychology, computer science, and neuroscience. We continuously research the latest findings in cognitive enhancement, neuroplasticity, and brain training methodologies to ensure our platform incorporates evidence-based practices. We're committed to transparency about our methods and staying current with scientific research in the field.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.description: We value feedback from our community and are always looking to improve. If you have questions, suggestions, or want to learn more about our platform, please don't hesitate to contact us. We're here to support your cognitive training journey.
